convert.queued_hint: Added to the conversion queue ({preset}). See the Convert tab.
convert.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg not found. Set it up in Settings.
library.empty_hint: Pair your phone on the Receive tab, then send from the phone.
jobs.title: Conversions
jobs.empty:
Click "Convert" in the library or viewer.
Originals are always kept; results go to the _converted folder in your library.
receive.title: Receive from phone
receive.no_port: No usable port (tried {ports}). Check whether security software is blocking LocalRoll.
receive.scan_title: Scan with LocalRoll on your phone
receive.scan_body: Your phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi. After pairing once, the phone app finds this PC automatically.
receive.or_pin: Or enter this pairing code on your phone
receive.no_address: No local network address found. Check your network connection.
receive.firewall_button: Phone can't connect? Allow through firewall
receive.firewall_fail: Not added (administrator permission may have been declined)
settings.library_hint: Photos and videos are stored by year/month; conversions go to _converted; files from other PCs go to the “Documents” and “Other files” subfolders.
settings.ffmpeg_title: ffmpeg (needed for HEIC display, thumbnails and conversion)
settings.ffmpeg_not_here: No working ffmpeg at this path
settings.ffmpeg_order: Search order: the path above → ffmpeg\ffmpeg.exe next to the app → system PATH. ffmpeg 7.1 or newer is required to decode iPhone HEIC correctly.
viewer.needs_ffmpeg: Showing {ext} requires ffmpeg. Set it up in Settings.
app.already_running: LocalRoll is already running. Use the open window (check the taskbar or the system tray) and close this one.
exit.title: Quit LocalRoll?
exit.body: Phones won’t be able to send to this PC until you open LocalRoll again.
exit.body_busy: {count} file(s) are still being received. Quitting stops them; the phone can resume later.
pair.check: Check that your phone shows the same three symbols, then allow.
identity.title: This PC
identity.preview_hint: This is how phones see this PC.
identity.name: Name
identity.picture_error: This picture can’t be opened. Try a JPG or PNG.
receive.tap_hint: On your phone, open LocalRoll and tap “{name}” — then click Allow here.
app.close_viewer: Close and go back to the library
settings.autostart_hint: Opens minimised, so phones can always send to this PC.
lib.delete_body: They go to the Windows Recycle Bin, so you can still restore them. Phones will be told next time they connect that these are no longer on this PC.
receive.blocked_title: Phones may not find this PC yet
receive.blocked_public: Windows Firewall hasn’t let LocalRoll in, and this Wi-Fi is set as a “Public” network. Allow it once (Windows will ask for permission).
receive.blocked_firewall: Windows Firewall hasn’t let LocalRoll in yet. Allow it once (Windows will ask for permission).
family.title: Family
family.hint: Each paired phone belongs to a family member. Several phones of one person are grouped and shown as “Anna 1”, “Anna 2”. The name comes from the phone and can be changed here.
family.folder_per_member_hint: New photos are saved as Name/Year/Month. Photos already received stay where they are. Tip: with a separate Windows account per person you can also restrict who may open each folder.
lib.offline: The library folder can't be reached ({path}) — external drive unplugged, or the folder moved? Receiving is paused and nothing is marked as deleted. It resumes by itself when the folder is back.
lib.missing_ask: {count} files are no longer in the library folder (deleted or moved in Explorer?). If you deleted them on purpose, confirm — the phones will then show them as no longer backed up.
home.receive_body: Pair a phone with the QR code, then send from the phone.
home.library_body: Browse, search and open everything the phones sent.
home.convert_body: HEIC → JPG, HEVC → H.264, Live Photos → video.
home.recent_none: Nothing yet. Send something from a phone.
home.disk_free: {free} free · room for about {count} more items
home.issue_offline: The library folder is not available (drive unplugged?).
home.issue_missing: {count} files are gone from the folder. Confirm or undo.
home.issue_server: Receiving is off. Phones cannot send.
home.issue_firewall: Windows Firewall may block phones. Allow it on the Receive page.
home.issue_ffmpeg: Video tools are missing: videos cannot be converted.
home.issue_disk: Less than 5 GB free on the library drive.
send.title: Send to a PC
send.hint: Send files, folders or photos to another PC running LocalRoll on the same network. Interrupted transfers continue where they stopped.
send.no_paired: No PC paired yet. Pair one from the list below.
send.none_nearby: No other PC found. Open LocalRoll on the other PC, then press Search.
send.received_folder: Files from other PCs are saved in
send.forget_body: Like Disconnect, and this PC also stops listing it under “Nearby” (you can show it again there). Files already sent stay where they are.
send.pair_check: Check that the other PC shows the same three symbols.
send.err_peer_offline: The other PC is not reachable. Is it on, with LocalRoll open?
send.err_not_paired: The other PC no longer knows this one. Pair again.
send.err_library_offline: The other PC's library folder is not available (drive unplugged?).
send.err_file_missing: A file was moved or deleted before it was sent.
send.err_file_changed: A file changed while it was being sent. Send it again.
send.err_pair_expired: Nobody answered on the other PC in time.
send.err_cannot_reach: Could not reach the other PC.
send.err_sha256_mismatch: A file arrived damaged and was not kept. Send it again.
send.err_too_many_attempts: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
pair.check_pc: Check that the other PC shows the same three symbols. Allowing lets both PCs send to each other.
send.err_cert_changed: The other PC shows a different security certificate (reinstalled, or something is in between). For safety nothing was sent. Forget it and pair again.
send.err_upgrade_required: This device must use an encrypted connection. Update LocalRoll on it.
send.err_not_lan: Only devices on the same home or office network can connect.
receive.not_encrypted: Encryption unavailable (certificate could not be created) — transfers are not encrypted.
common.clear_hint: Only removes finished entries from this list on this PC. No file is deleted, and the other device is not affected.
send.where: Photos and videos go into the other PC’s library. PDF and Office documents go into the “Documents” folder and everything else (archives, whole folders…) into the “Other files” folder — both inside the same library folder.
send.disconnect_body: Both PCs stop sending to each other. Each still sees the other under “Nearby” and can pair again with one click. Files already sent stay where they are.
send.drag_hint: You can also drag files or folders from Explorer onto a PC above.
text.saved: Saved as {name} in the Documents folder.
receive.other_ways_hint: Scan the QR code or type the PIN on the phone instead.
lib.recent: Just received: {count} items from {from} (they are placed by the date they were taken, so older ones are further down).
lib.recent_only: Showing only what arrived in the last 24 hours.
settings.auto_accept_hint: On: paired phones and PCs send without asking. Off: the first transfer from each device waits for “Accept” here; after that it may keep sending for 30 minutes.
incoming.title: “{name}” wants to send you files
incoming.window: If you accept, what this device sends in the next 30 minutes is received without asking again. Turn on “Receive automatically” in Settings to never be asked.
files.delete_body: It goes to the Recycle Bin; you can restore it from there.
files.empty_docs:
No documents yet.
PDF, Word, Excel… sent from another PC appear here.
files.empty_other:
Nothing here yet.
Archives, whole folders and other files sent from another PC appear here.
